items.question: Which additional female figures are included in the ongoing enumeration of devoted beings?
premises: The verse names ulukī and pecakī as female figures.
The verse further names sararī and gūlī as female figures.
The particles vā and tathā mark alternatives and continued inclusion in the list.
items.inference: These names extend the preceding enumeration with additional female figures.
uncertainties: The precise identity or species associated with sararī is unclear.
The precise identity or species associated with gūlī is unclear.
items.plain_english: The owl-woman, the peacock-woman, or indeed the sararī-woman, or the gūlī-woman likewise.
